category_title: Students with situational noncompliance in low-engagement settings
scenario_title: Whole-class synonym lesson with computer distractions
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be participating in a whole-class lesson on synonyms but is distracted by a computer in the loud classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, please sit down so we can start our whole-class lesson on synonyms.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the instruction and walks away from the group)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kanita, we are doing synonyms right now. Please come back.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits down at the computer and opens up Math Corner instead of joining the lesson)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kanita, do not do Math Corner on the computer right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am going to do it anyway.
